latestVersion.changelog:
One More Shot AI — Initial Release

- Launches "One More Shot AI" skill for regenerating, fixing, and exporting 1080p video shots using AI, from simple text instructions.
- Supports easy upload of raw video footage and rapid, no-timeline editing workflows, with download-ready results in 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic setup and authentication, including anonymous token and session management (100 free credits, valid 7 days).
- Cloud-based rendering pipeline, supporting video, audio, and text overlays; exports in formats like MP4, MOV, AVI, and more.
- Keyword-based prompt routing for common actions: upload, export, check credits/balance, status, and scene edits.
- Robust error handling with user-friendly prompts and tip guidance.
